text:
Given below is a text with some words missing (Blank 1-2). Choose the most suitable words to complete the text.

The company's sudden decline was not caused by market conditions alone. Years of poor planning and careless spending left the management completely 1) _______ to deal with competition. Investors who once trusted the firm are now reluctant to support it. Experts believe that unless strict reforms are introduced, further losses are 2) _______.

Blank 1: A. equipped  B. incapable  C. determined  D. delighted
Blank 2: A. avoidable  B. uncertain  C. inevitable  D. flexible
explanation:
Blank 1: 'Incapable' (B) means lacking the ability or skill — it fits perfectly because poor planning left management unable to handle competition. 'Equipped' is the opposite; 'determined' and 'delighted' don't convey inability.

Blank 2: 'Inevitable' (C) means certain to happen and impossible to avoid — it logically follows the warning that without reforms, losses will definitely continue. 'Avoidable' contradicts the warning tone; 'uncertain' and 'flexible' don't fit the context of guaranteed losses.

Blank 2: 'Fruitful' (C) means producing good results — disciplined effort eventually yields success. 'Pointless' and 'harmful' are negative and contradict the encouraging tone; 'delayed' doesn't describe the quality of effort.

Blank 2: A. inaccurate  B. authentic  C. irrelevant  D. suspicious
explanation:
